name: FIRST ORBIT
desc: First crew capsule to reach LEO and return alive.
requires: Crew Capsule at LEO, then return to Earth

name: FIRST MOON LANDING
desc: First crew to land on Moon surface and return alive.
requires: Crew Capsule lands on Moon, returns to Earth

name: FIRST ROBOT ON MARS
desc: First unmanned probe to land on Mars.
requires: Robotic lander on Mars surface

name: FIRST CREW ON MARS
desc: First crew to land on Mars and return alive to Earth. Requires pre-deployed Greenhouse OR Martian ISRU.
requires: Crew on Mars surface + return to Earth

name: LARGEST SPACE STATION
desc: Most cargo tokens attached to a Crew Habitat in Earth orbit (LEO).
requires: Habitat in LEO + most attached tokens
note: Stealable: claim transfers when another player surpasses you

name: LARGEST LUNAR BASE
desc: Most cargo tokens attached to a Crew Habitat on the Moon.
requires: Habitat on Moon + most attached tokens

name: LARGEST MARTIAN BASE
desc: Most cargo tokens attached to a Crew Habitat on Mars.
requires: Habitat on Mars + most attached tokens

name: RESCUE
desc: Bring another player's stranded crew home alive.
requires: Rendezvous with stranded craft + return crew to Earth

name: MARS SAMPLE RETURN
desc: Deliver a Sample Container to Mars surface, then return it to Earth.
requires: Sample Container lands on Mars, returns to Earth surface

name: VENERA
desc: Deliver 10t (1 yellow token) past Earth escape + 1 Dv into deep space.
requires: 10t at escape + 1 Dv

name: INTERNATIONAL STATION
desc: Deliver cargo to a Crew Habitat built by another player. The cargo joins their station; place markers on this card matching your delivery size. Claim the card. Any later delivery to another player's station that exceeds the highest single delivery on the card steals it; new claimant places their markers, old markers stay.
requires: Single delivery of cargo to another player's orbital Habitat
note: Stealable by larger single delivery. Markers track contributions

name: CASSINI
desc: Deliver 10t past Earth escape + 4 Dv into deep space.
requires: 10t at escape + 4 Dv

name: VOYAGER
desc: Deliver 10t past Earth escape + 5 Dv into deep space.
requires: 10t at escape + 5 Dv

name: NEW HORIZONS
desc: Deliver 10t past Earth escape + 8 Dv into deep space.
requires: 10t at escape + 8 Dv

name: JWST
desc: Deploy a Science Package at Earth escape + 1 Dv. Requires Solar Array.
requires: Science Package at escape + 1 Dv with Solar Array

name: MARS COLONY
desc: 4-person crew on Mars surface, sustained by a Greenhouse, for 12 months.
requires: 4 crew + Habitat + Greenhouse on Mars, 12 turns endurance

name: COMSAT
desc: Deliver 1 equipment (communications satellite) to LEO.
requires: 1 equipment at LEO

name: GPS CONSTELLATION
desc: Deliver 3 equipment (navigation satellites) to LEO in a single launch.
requires: 3 equipment at LEO, one launch
note: An Equipment Bundle x3 does it in one action

name: TV BROADCAST
desc: Deliver 1 equipment (broadcast satellite) to Geostationary Orbit.
requires: 1 equipment at GEO

name: ORBITAL TOURIST
desc: Carry a Crew Capsule to LEO and return the guest alive.
requires: Crew Capsule to LEO + Atmospheric Return home

name: SPECIAL DELIVERY
desc: Lob 10t (1 yellow) to DV5, ballistic. Don't ask questions.
requires: 10t at DV5 · pays on delivery

name: UNNAMED PAYLOAD
desc: Lob 20t (2 yellow) to DV6, ballistic. Don't ask questions.
requires: 20t at DV6 · pays on delivery

name: INTERCONTINENTAL EXPRESS
desc: Lob 10t (1 yellow) to DV7, ballistic. Don't ask questions.
requires: 10t at DV7 · pays on delivery

name: MAXIMUM THROW
desc: Lob 40t (1 orange) to DV8, ballistic. Don't ask questions.
requires: 40t at DV8 · pays on delivery

name: WEATHER WATCH
desc: Deploy a Science Package in LEO and keep it there 4 months.
requires: Science Package at LEO, 4 turns

name: HALLEY ARMADA
desc: Fly a Science Package past Earth escape +2 Dv to meet a comet.
requires: Science Package at escape +2 Dv

name: SOLAR PROBE
desc: Deliver a Science Package sunward to escape +4 Dv. Requires Atmospheric Return as heat shield.
requires: Science Package + Atmospheric Return at escape +4 Dv

name: ICE MOON SURVEY
desc: Deliver a Science Package + RTG to escape +6 Dv, out among the outer-planet moons.
requires: Science Package + RTG at escape +6 Dv
